adjudications.resolution: Add an explicit no-user-facing-surface skip gate and an authorized narrow runtime-preparation return path; stage 15 still grants no lifecycle approval.
Add first-class non-executable safety dispositions which precede all normal targets and return a separately authorized next route.
Uphold smallest-sufficient routing: use test-runtime-bootstrap and tool-runtime-readiness for the two atomic cases; reserve stage 15 for multi-capability or unresolved support ownership.
Represent explicit-human-approval and separate-remediation-capability as first-class non-executable control points in the route graph.
Reclassify non-causal semantic-marker behavioral mutations as deterministic-only; require an independent causal challenge before reporting killed or survived.
Challenge lifecycle release-readiness approval separately from per-action remote authorization.
